source_note: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求
english_source_note: Difference Conditions for Uniform Distribution mod 1
callout_id: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求#2
statement_en:
If the sequence $y_n$ is Abel summable and its Abel sum converges to $a$, that is,
$$\lim_{x\to 1^{-}}\sum_{n\geq 0}y_nx^n=a,$$
and moreover $y_n = O\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)$, then the series itself converges to $a$:
$$\sum_{n\geq 0}y_n = a.$$
callout_body: 如果序列$y_n$是Abel可和的，且Abel和收敛到$a$，即$$\lim_{x\to 1^{-}}\sum_{n\geq 0}y_nx^n=a$$并且$y_n = O\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)$那么该序列的和收敛到$a$:$$\sum_{n\geq 0}y_n = a$$
